# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster / Teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Pidgeon has a mustache that he frequently twirls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Pidgeon is romantic, dramatic, and prone to favoritism, spending most of his time attentive to Sukey Pullen while ignoring other students and the younger classes. He utilizes a sarcastic, mocking tone toward his students that they detest, and he can be stern, severe, or emotional depending on the situation.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

- Twirls his mustache  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- Wooing and tutoring Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>

## History

Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster for the Brierley school during Nell Harcourt's first year in the community. His position was secured through his uncle, who was a dominant school trustee. As a teacher, he focused most of his efforts on older pupils preparing for the Regent's Academy exam—particularly Sukey Pullen, with whom he was hopelessly in love—while neglecting the younger children. During class, he frequently sat with Sukey to clarify coursework, wrote messages on her slate, and twirled his mustache. On one occasion, when Nell Harcourt reacted to Hugh Carrow pulling her hair by smashing a slate over Hugh's head, Pidgeon disciplined Nell by forcing her to stand on the dais before the blackboard with a reprimand written above her. Later, after a group of students arrived late to class, Pidgeon singled out Nell and forced her to sit beside Hugh Carrow as a penalty, prompting Nell to temporarily quit attending school. Pidgeon also participated in local community events; at the Sunday-school picnic, he brought attendees out rowing on the Lake of Glassy Waters, and at the Brierley Debating Club concert, he delivered Mark Antony's address above Caesar's form. At the end of the school term, he gave a moving farewell speech to his students, which brought many to tears, before departing Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073), [v1 c15 P77](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0077), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
